adaptations: React hook state becomes ReviewApp-owned native state shared by Ratatui rendering, menus, commands, and the subprocess extension host.

Retained JavaScript closures become native host actions resolved against current selection, draft, registration, and review facts at application time; the mount authority bridge revokes predecessor capabilities on hard remount.
A lifecycle response may carry both ordered host actions and a contained failure, preserving Hunk's synchronous action-before-throw semantics without executing extension code in-process.
Monotonic activation and registration identities replace JavaScript object identity for reentrant handoff, key-exit ownership, reload, and registry replacement.
Qualified extension:view targets are resolved against the unified registry; bare ids stay scoped to their caller, matching Hunk's control lookup.
Native lifecycle recursion is capped at 32 nested transitions so a trusted but faulty subprocess cannot overflow the host stack.
The complete Changeset remains the bulk target authority even when the file filter hides matching files; the selected-file menu is absent when its file is not in the visible stream.
